summary: Land acquisition for planned development; validity of release claim dependent on Change of Land Use (CLU) compliance; acquisition proceedings completed in 1995; appellant failed to obtain mandatory CLU for industrial use; State policy requires CLU for release; no discrimination despite comparable cases where CLU existed; significant infrastructure expenditure incurred; pre-Award possession recorded as compliant; writ dismissed by High Court for delay, laches and res judicata; CLU prerequisite established as conclusive factor.
legal_provisions_cited: Punjab Scheduled Roads & Controlled Areas Restrictions of Land Use (CLU) Unregulated Development Act, 1963 s.4(1)(a)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order upholding rejection of land release sustained; no entitlement due to missing CLU and completed acquisition process.
